description: This file defines the AgentEventStore class, which manages a collection of ControlAgentEvent instances, providing methods to append and clear events, and implementing singleton access.

classes.name: AgentEventStore
classes.description: A singleton class that stores and manages a list of ControlAgentEvent objects, with capacity limiting.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Adds a new event to the store, removing oldest events if capacity exceeds maxEvents.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Removes all events from the store.
